newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four Russians drown trying to cross Volga by car.
newsitem.headline: Four Russians drown trying to cross Volga by car.

text.p: Four Russians hoping to find an ideal fishing spot died when the ice cracked as they tried to drive across the frozen Volga River, Interfax news agency said.
The only man to survive the incident said the group thought they might have better luck fishing for perch on the other bank of the river near the town of Yuryevets in the Ivanovo region.
The Russian love for spring ice fishing has proved fatal before.
Three men drowned and 13 were rescued at the end of March in the Far East when ice floes broke up in storms and 40 had to be rescued from drifting ice on a lake.
